statements.label: Proposition 1
statements.restatement: With d=1, real r,k,v, w>0, r!=k, x=(v(2r-k)-1)/(r-k), y=k(1-rv)/(w(r-k)): the cost q f2+p f1+j f53+c f12+e f8+f18+b f7+a f15 is >= 0 on SO(4) if p>=x^2+y^2, j>=r^2(1+v^2), c>=k^2(1+v^2), a,e>=v^2, b>=w^2, q>=0. A pointwise inequality on coefficients, no realizability.

statements.label: Proposition 2
statements.restatement: For b,j>0, c>=0: p f1+j f53+c f12+b f7+f18 >= 0 on SO(4) if p >= (b+c)/(b(sqrt j+sqrt c)^2) when jc<=b^2, p >= 1/(j+b) when jc>=b^2; boundary cases j=0 (chain 1/c+1/b), c=0 (SOC 1/j), b=0 (SOC 1/j).

statements.label: scalar test (1)
statements.restatement: With m=min(a,e), J=sqrt j, C=sqrt c, b>0, J+C>0: if some t in [0, sqrt(m/(1+m))] gives p >= [((2J+C)t-1)^2/(1-t^2) + c(1-Jt)^2/b]/(J+C)^2, the cost is >= 0 on SO(4).
